name: Behind Closed Doors
description: Investigate four residents' apartments for evidence of disloyal activity and report to Pavel Sokolov.
offerText: There is a confidential matter that requires your attention.

stages.description: Search apartments 11, 22, 41 and 42 in the Living District for suspicious correspondence. Use a lockpick to enter locked rooms. Bring any evidence you find to the clerk.
Bring the suspicious letter to Pavel Sokolov.
